title.es: Variable roja en el campo profundo
title.en: Red variable in the deep field

blurb.es: Gaia DR3 2257667121267351296: variable roja (BP−RP = 2.7, G = 14.1, K = 10.4) a 1.4° del polo norte eclíptico, elegida por no saturar. 143–157 visitas por detector en 17 meses: se muestran 48. Su curva de luz honesta es por canal fijo, no por visita.
blurb.en: Gaia DR3 2257667121267351296: red variable (BP−RP = 2.7, G = 14.1, K = 10.4) 1.4° from the North Ecliptic Pole, chosen because it does not saturate. 143–157 visits per detector in 17 months: 48 are shown. Its honest light curve is at fixed channel, not per visit.
